dedupe_keys.name: china multi regional input output table 2012

description: This Figshare collection publishes a 2012 multi-regional input-output table for China and the MATLAB code used to compile it. The table represents interdependencies among regional economic outputs, which can inform industrial supply-chain or energy-demand propagation in a multi-sector simulation. The own collection API names one XLSX table and one code item. Such input-output coefficients describe monetary production relationships, not the location or capacity of individual factories and networks. A model using them should distinguish economic flows from physical infrastructure dependencies. The 2012 baseline is historical and may not reflect current industrial geography. DataCite states CC BY 4.0 for the collection DOI. I read the Scientific Data descriptor and own Figshare metadata without opening the workbook or executing MATLAB. No exact record or explicit parent coverage appeared in the comparison collections. A caveat is that monetary input-output coefficients do not establish physical supply routes. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
